name: 黃沙王陵
art: An ancient desert royal necropolis; a large stepped pyramid and obelisks in upper-right outside the traversable clearing, sandstone tomb walls at edges; broad pale sandstone crossroads and empty central ceremonial floor.
prompt: Original hand-painted pre-rendered-looking 2D isometric dark fantasy RPG game asset. Cohesive weathered stone, iron, wood and natural materials, readable midtones and clear paths, atmospheric deep shadows only around architecture, restrained warm torchlight and cool ambient fill. Crisp details at gameplay scale, no blur, no photo, no modern 3D perspective. No commercial game copies, logos, text, characters, monsters, HUD, frames or watermark. Landscape 4:3 orthographic ground tile. An ancient desert royal necropolis; a large stepped pyramid and obelisks in upper-right outside the traversable clearing, sandstone tomb walls at edges; broad pale sandstone crossroads and empty central ceremonial floor. STRICT WALKABILITY COMPOSITION: the middle 52% width by 46% height is completely clear traversable ground. A wide straight unobstructed road extends from the center to the EXACT CENTER of EACH of all FOUR edges (north, east, south, west). No object, cliff, water, stairs or wall may cross these four paths. At all four edge midpoints the road surface fills at least 18% of that edge. Paths blend smoothly to edge with no dark frame. Trees, tall ruins, water, pits and buildings stay in outer corner quadrants. Near overhead 3/4 orthographic camera, no sky or horizon. Asset is to connect with neighboring terrain tiles, all roads at precise edge centers.
